set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem algebra_amgm_sum1toneqn_prod1tonleq1
  (a : ℕ → NNReal)
  (n : ℕ)
  (h₀ : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x = n) :
  ∏ x ∈ Finset.range n, a x ≤ 1 := by
  -- Use the AM-GM inequality for non-negative real numbers
  -- The arithmetic mean equals 1 since sum = n and there are n terms
  -- By AM-GM, geometric mean ≤ arithmetic mean = 1
  -- Therefore product ≤ 1^n = 1
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    -- When n = 0, both sum and product over empty range are 0 and 1 respectively
    simp_all [Finset.sum_range_zero, Finset.prod_range_zero]
  | succ n' =>
    -- For n > 0, apply AM-GM inequality
    -- Convert to Real for easier manipulation
    have h₁ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
      -- Apply AM-GM: geometric mean ≤ arithmetic mean
      have h₂ : 0 < (n + 1 : ℝ) := by positivity
      have h₃ : ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ) = (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
        norm_cast at h₀ ⊢
        simpa using h₀
      -- Use the fact that geometric mean ≤ arithmetic mean
      have h₄ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) ^ ((n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤ (∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) / (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
        -- Apply AM-GM inequality for non-negative reals
        exact Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean (fun i _ => by exact NNReal.coe_nonneg (a i)) (Finset.range (n + 1))
      -- Simplify the right side to get 1
      rw [h₃] at h₄
      have h₅ : ((∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) / (n + 1 : ℝ)) = 1 := by
        field_simp [h₃]
        <;> ring_nf
        <;> norm_num
      rw [h₅] at h₄
      -- Raise both sides to power (n+1) to get the product bound
      have h₆ : (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) ≤ 1 := by
        have h₇ : 0 ≤ ∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.prod_nonneg
          intro i _
          exact NNReal.coe_nonneg (a i)
        calc
          (∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) = ((∏ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (a x : ℝ)) ^ ((n + 1 : ℝ)⁻¹)) ^ (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
            rw [← Real.rpow_mul (by positivity)]
            <;> field_simp [h₂.ne']
            <;> ring_nf
          _ ≤ (1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 : ℝ) := by gcongr
          _ = 1 := by simp
      exact h₆
    -- Convert back to NNReal
    norm_cast at h₁ ⊢
    exact_mod_cast h₁

      intro x hx

      exact NNReal.coe_nonneg _
